extracted.intended_audience: fundraisers, nonprofit staff and leaders seeking training in grantseeking, proposal writing, fundraising, and nonprofit management
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog of live webinars, on-demand courses, and in-person trainings that teach nonprofit professionals how to find funders, write proposals and budgets, demonstrate impact, build relationships with funders, and use Candid products and transparency seals to improve fundraising outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospecting funders / effective first approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Kickstart your grantseeking journey using Candid. Learn how to effectively prospect funders and make a strong first approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on researching funders that match your mission and preparing an initial outreach that makes a strong first impression; practical use of Candid search tools is emphasized where noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using Candid search and products to find funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to use Candid search and other Candid products to identify funders, download search results, and build prospect lists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes demos of Candid features, guidance on keyword/location filters, and tips for exporting and using search results to prioritize outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top grantseeking tips / efficient funder research
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage expert grantseeking tips to find grants more efficiently and effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short, actionable best-practice tips for saving time and improving the quality of funder research and selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building a funder prospect list
rubrics_metrics.description: Spend less time looking for funders and more time focusing on your mission by building a funder prospect list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical steps to identify, prioritize, and maintain a prospect list for sustained outreach and cultivation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identifying and connecting with best-matched funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Build connections with funders already supporting missions like yours by identifying best matches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes alignment of mission/program with funder priorities and strategies for initiating contact and relationship-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leveraging personalized tools and AI for fundraising
rubrics_metrics.description: Elevate fundraising with personalized tools and AI to uncover funding recommendations and simplify outreach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use data-driven recommendations and automation to surface relevant funders and streamline communications while maintaining personalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partner identification for nonprofit collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: How to search for a nonprofit to partner with using keyword, location, and other research criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on identifying aligned partners, using platform search filters, and evaluating fit for collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloading and exporting funder search results
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to download search results on Candid search for offline analysis and outreach planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical instruction on exporting data and integrating results into prospecting workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Making major foundation and corporate grant applications stand out
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify key actions needed to launch or grow your major grants program, including foundation and corporate grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on tailoring applications, demonstrating organizational capacity, and highlighting what differentiates your program for major funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crafting compelling and effective foundation grant proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn to craft compelling and effective foundation grant proposals in an advanced multi-week boot camp.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In-depth instruction on proposal structure, narrative clarity, evidence of impact, and persuasive framing to increase funder appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversifying funding beyond federal sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Build a diversified revenue strategy to ensure stability by seeking non-federal funding streams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical strategies to identify and pursue foundation, corporate, individual, and other revenue sources to reduce reliance on federal funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to proposal writing — basics of strong proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn the basics of crafting strong, compelling proposals that will help you secure grants from foundations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers core components of proposals, clarity of need, goals and outcomes, and alignment with funder priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders' perspective: what makes a good fundraising proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Get a funder's perspective on how to write a great fundraising proposal and stand out from other applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insight into funder decision-making, common pitfalls, and elements that increase competitiveness from a reviewer’s viewpoint.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three top tips for writing grant proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical top tips from grant writing experts to improve proposals and win more funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise advice on prioritizing clarity, alignment, and evidence in proposal writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: What funders look for in grant proposal budgets
rubrics_metrics.description: Get tips for mastering proposal budgets, an important factor in grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance includes how to present realistic, justified costs, link budget items to activities/outcomes, and demonstrate fiscal responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upgrading budgets to attract major foundation funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Maximize grant budget potential and make your application stand out to major foundation funders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advanced budgeting practices, justification of expenses, and strategies to present budgets that reflect strategic planning and sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to project budgets — basic elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn the basic elements of how to draft a project budget for a grant proposal with confidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step coverage of common budget categories, allowable costs, and linking expenses to project activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes thinking / measuring your impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply an outcomes thinking framework to your nonprofit’s programs to measure impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define outcomes, select indicators, and design measurement approaches that demonstrate program effectiveness to funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telling your nonprofit's story / digital storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Use storytelling frameworks and digital tools to improve clarity and engagement with supporters and funders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Four key components of compelling storytelling, practical techniques for online communication, and using story to convey impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seals of Transparency and Candid profile management
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how Candid Seals of Transparency build credibility, trust, and visibility with funders, and how to claim and manage your organization profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Steps to claim profiles, what information to add for different Seal levels, and ongoing profile maintenance to retain visibility and access to tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earning Candid Seals: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Bronze: basic profile; Silver: program and population information; Gold: financial and demographic transparency; Platinum: goals, strategies, and outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each Seal level requires progressively deeper disclosure of programs, populations served, finances, and demonstrated impact to build funder trust and access features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promoting and maintaining your Seal of Transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: How to promote your Seal and keep your profile up to date so you never lose transparency status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on communicating Seal achievements to funders/donors and operational practices to ensure continued compliance with Seal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Readiness checklist before seeking grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether your nonprofit is ready to start seeking foundation grants using a step-by-step checklist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess organizational capacity, program readiness, governance, financial systems, and clarity of mission before pursuing grant opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using donor data to develop KPIs
rubrics_metrics.description: Put donor data to work: five frameworks to develop top KPIs and improve decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How to leverage existing donor data to define meaningful KPIs that track fundraising performance and inform strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collecting and using demographic data
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical tips on gathering demographic information and how it can boost funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Best practices for data collection, privacy considerations, and using demographic data to demonstrate reach and equity to funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reducing barriers in demographic reporting for grantees
rubrics_metrics.description: How funders can help reduce barriers and support grantees around collecting and reporting demographic data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discussion of funder/grantee collaboration to streamline reporting requirements and reduce administrative burden on nonprofits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board engagement in fundraising
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical tips for engaging your board in fundraising and harnessing their collective capacity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers common board fundraising challenges, role expectations, and strategies to activate board members effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity-centered leadership and inclusive organizational practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Courses on people-centered leadership, incorporating equity into hiring and organizational values, and building inclusive cultures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes centering marginalized leadership, equitable hiring practices, organizational values that support DEI, and strategic communications for racial equity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disability and LGBTQ+ inclusion best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on disability-inclusive workplaces and creating more inclusive environments for LGBTQ+ staff and partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical steps to advance accessibility, inclusive hiring, and workplace policies that support marginalized staff and partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sector-specific fundraising topics (DAFs, corporate giving, disaster fundraising)
rubrics_metrics.description: Targeted guidance on donor-advised funds, corporate grantmakers, and fundraising around natural disasters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers donor-advised fund decision drivers, how corporate grantmaking differs from foundations, and proactive/reactive disaster fundraising strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using Foundation Directory and other tools to find grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover how to identify funders and find grants using Foundation Directory and related research tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical instruction on searching databases, refining queries, and translating research into a prioritized prospect pipeline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying an asset-based community development and partnership approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Leverage community assets to enhance impact and form strategic partnerships that support funding and program success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principles and practices for identifying community strengths, co-designing programs with partners, and demonstrating community-centered impact to funders.
